findings.title: A plan-only PR merges unchecked and turns main red
findings.label: valid
findings.note: tests.yml now skips PRs touching only docs/plans/** while push to main is unfiltered, and the new guard only greps test files for literal docs/plans/*.md paths, so a by-type scan (e.g. Biome's '**' includes) or a computed path can break main after merge.

findings.title: The new filter evaluator makes a coverage guard pass for a filter that drops a binding input
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: negationRemovesAll does deliberately fail open on file-type negations, but this only affects a hypothetical future filter, and the finding itself says the fail-closed coverage guards would still catch it, leaving at most stale comment guidance.

findings.title: lint-release.yml's justification for not running test:scripts is now slightly out of date
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The lint-release.yml comment saying test:scripts runs on every PR is now slightly inaccurate, but none of the files it covers are under docs/plans, so this is only comment wording.
